title: 数据科学与机器学习笔记本项目
summary: 一个包含数据科学、机器学习、深度学习及大语言模型（LLM）实战项目的仓库，涵盖生成式AI与AI代理，展示构建能思考、规划与行动的智能系统的经验。
summary_en: A repository of hands-on projects in data science, ML, deep learning, and LLMs, including generative AI and AI agents, demonstrating experience in building intelligent systems that can think, plan, and act.
